cards.card_text: Then the LORD points Job to a creature: "Look at Behemoth, which I made along with you." Same Maker, friend.

cards.card_text: Even when the river rages, Behemoth stays unafraid and secure.
cards.verse_text: Though the river rages, Behemoth is unafraid; he remains secure, though the Jordan surges to his mouth.
